info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Evaluation API
Microsoft Windows 10 Evaluate model with input data

params.name: sessionId
params.description: Unique identifier for the evaluation session

items.docs: Evaluates the model with bound input data using LearningModelSession.Evaluate. Input features are bound via a LearningModelBinding, and results are returned as a LearningModelEvaluationResult containing output tensors, maps, sequences, or images.
